Evidence: at 1793053585.00 s u_brown was at z=0.0564 (seated z 0.0434, so ~13 mm up) and tilted ~8 deg (qx -0.650 vs -0.707). Over the next 0.5 s it fell back to z 0.0434 and is now 2.9 mm from its pre-step snapshot, 2.2 mm from its live placement frame. In the same instant base1 jumped 8.6 mm (obs_base_fixtures fire) and settled ~3 mm from run start; the finger effort dropped from 63.8 to 52.4, consistent with a contact impulse on the held part. Believed mechanism: during insertion the carried u_orange (or the fixture it pushed) struck u_brown or base1 outside the intended seating contact, jolting base1 and kicking u_brown briefly out of its seat. The clause says a previously seated part must not move beyond its position tolerance from its pre-step snapshot, and u_brown did, if only transiently, so this is a departure. u_brown re-seated on its own; its end state remains within placement tolerance. Also: place_approach_u_orange carried no target_offset; the executor used a 5 cm standoff (same as u_brown's authored one), so the final descent began from the same height as for u_brown.

payload.explanation: inverted_u_yellow itself seated within tolerance: 2.4 mm and 1.3 deg against its live frame. Grasp width 42.6 vs 40 mm, lift 0.300 m, no slip or clamp fire (finger effort peaked ~97 vs limit 250). During the slow final descent the arm loaded up heavily (shoulder_lift 437, elbow 474 effort units at 1.5 mm above target), so the part was being driven down against resistance, most likely line_green, which lies under or beside it in the centre slot, and base1. Arm-joint effort has no registry bound, so that invariant cannot be judged numerically. The release relieved it. Consequence: line_green moved 1.67 mm and base1 (and with it the placement frames) shifted ~0.6 mm. That leaves line_green 15.004 mm from its live frame (steady across 11 samples; y error 14.7 mm, z 2.8 mm) against its 15 mm registry tolerance, outside by 4 micrometres. line_green had settled only marginally inside tolerance (13.6 mm) after its jammed placement, so this small disturbance pushed it over. Each part's displacement from its pre-step snapshot is within its own tolerance, but line_green's end-state no longer meets its placement tolerance. Re-seating it would require removing the now-seated inverted_u_yellow, so the executor is not attempting it.

payload.explanation: All twelve steps ran and all four parts are on base1. The end-state is non-conformant because line_green sits 15.004 mm from its live placement frame against a 15 mm registry tolerance (steady over 11 samples). It is outside by only 4 micrometres, but outside. u_brown (2.3 mm), u_orange (2.2 mm) and inverted_u_yellow (2.4 mm, 1.3 deg) are within tolerance. Bystanders u_green, inverted_u_brown, hex_blue and hex_red never moved (no fire, end poses unchanged). base2 never moved but has no registry bound; base1 drifted ~2.5 mm net with no registry bound; both reported as observations. Findings and what became of each: (1) place_u_orange: u_brown was transiently kicked 15.2 mm out of its seat (> 10 mm) when the u_orange insertion jolted base1. It fell back on its own within 0.5 s and is within tolerance at run end, so this is corrected in end-state, though the disturbance happened. (2) place_line_green: in-hand slip exceeded 20 mm on both descents (20.1 and 20.4 mm). The part jammed ~3 cm above its seat both times, and after the reseat release it dropped to 13.6 mm (inside tolerance). A slip event cannot be undone, so this finding stands as a process departure. (3) place_inverted_u_yellow: the arm loaded up heavily (shoulder_lift ~437, elbow ~474) during the final descent, pressing on line_green/base1. That nudged line_green 1.67 mm and moved the frames ~0.6 mm, pushing line_green's end-state just past its tolerance. This is the standing violation, left uncorrected because re-seating line_green would require removing the seated inverted_u_yellow. Execution deviation: place_approach_u_orange had no authored target_offset; the executor used a 5 cm standoff to honour 'stopping clear of contact'. Observations: obs-001 base1 drift (no bound); obs-002 an unlisted red/orange ~5 cm cube appeared at (0.083, -0.381) between looks 0002 and 0003 and is still there (missed live by scene_watch_1, whose trigger was too coarse; found by a look and the trigger was then lowered); obs-003 a transient pale slab entered near base1 around place_line_green and left within ~20 s (resolved, no displacement caused). Unwatched properties: arm-joint effort (no registry bound) and base1/base2 displacement (no spec block), observed only.
